# Coverage

The inputs of the minimal test set (scripts/correctness/minimal.mjs) that no
other fixture holds: edits of fixtures that reach state-machine transitions
no fixture reaches. Generated; the dumps are C's, reviewed like any other.

```````````````````````````````` example
%# My Header

A paragraph.
.
Document scope=1:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%# My Header" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="A paragraph." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
# My Header

#-# My Header
.
Document scope=1:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="My Header" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="#-# My Header" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
    ├── Text scope=1:26..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b} " children=0
    ├── Cite scope=1:29..1:43 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Citation scope=1:29..1:43 anchor=null attributes={} referent=bib(key="a<![CDATA[--",mode=authorInText) children=0
    │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
    │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
    └── Text scope=1:44..1:67 anchor=null attributes={} literal="-->b} @{a{}b} @{} @{a b}" children=0
````````````````````````````````

